description: This file defines a class `JournalEntryAggregationJobExecutionDecider` that implements the `JobExecutionDecider` interface from Spring Batch. It contains logic to determine whether to proceed with or skip a journal entry aggregation job based on the date context stored within a job execution. The class decides to halt or continue the job depending on whether the aggregation for a specific date has already been performed, utilizing logging for informational purposes.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobExecutionDecider
classes.description: A Spring Batch job execution decider that determines whether to skip or continue the journal entry aggregation based on date comparison.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Implements the decision logic to determine if the job should proceed or be skipped, based on aggregation dates stored in the job's execution context.

methods.name: aggregationAlreadyExist
methods.description: Helper method to check if the aggregation for the given date range already exists, based on comparison of `lastAggregatedOnDate` and `aggregatedOnDate`.
